name: Advance Petrochemicals Limited
summary: Advance Petrochemicals Ltd. is a chemical company engaged in the production and distribution of a diverse range of products, including surface-active agents, various solvents, and specific ethanolamines such as alkyl aryl ethanolamine. Its extensive catalogue features items like aero engine coolant, aero fuel, components for air brakes, anti-seize compounds, brake fluid, general coolants, demulsifiers, ethylene glycol, monomethyl ether, and numerous other chemical substances. The firm was established on August 9, 1985, and its primary operations are headquartered in Ahmedabad, India.
